verdictSemantics: UNSUPPORTED is NOT PASS: recorded when the attack cannot be constructed against any public surface

cases.attack: forged identity (fabricated NodeId/fingerprint)
cases.expectedControl: refusal at durable peer admission BEFORE any signature evaluation; no signature oracle
cases.actualResult: stage=peer_admission failureCode=peer_not_admitted; no receipt, no inbox entry

cases.attack: wrong signature (body of A signed by B's key)
cases.expectedControl: refusal at the signature stage via the 24B verifier
cases.actualResult: stage=signature failureCode=signature_stage_refused

cases.attack: body tamper (payloadHash mutated after signing)
cases.expectedControl: signature covers the canonical body; any mutation refuses
cases.actualResult: stage=signature failureCode=signature_stage_refused

cases.attack: stale epoch (older sender epoch after a newer one)
cases.expectedControl: the 24A instance-epoch tracker refuses stale senders
cases.actualResult: second delivery refused ok=false (epoch freshness control held)

cases.attack: replay (same message id delivered twice in-epoch)
cases.expectedControl: once-ever message ids: second delivery refuses with zero re-evaluation
cases.actualResult: failureCode=replay_detected

cases.attack: duplicate proposal (same proposal id, two distinct signed messages)
cases.expectedControl: the record id IS the proposal-id commitment: duplicates refuse durably
cases.actualResult: failureCode=proposal_duplicate (stage=durable_admission)

cases.attack: downgrade/schema confusion (protocol v0, message schema v9, proposal schema v9)
cases.expectedControl: exact-equality protocol/schema pins refuse every downgrade at its own stage
cases.actualResult: protocol_mismatch (bus) + contract refusal (message schema) + proposal_schema_mismatch (payload)

cases.attack: capability inflation (proposal asks beyond the candidate/agent class)
cases.expectedControl: intent-class is inert; capabilities are the LOCAL choice; Day-1 Policy denies the inflated ask
cases.actualResult: candidate keeps local-only capabilities; workspace:write denied by Policy; gate refuses local_policy_denial

cases.attack: malicious authenticated peer (shell material smuggled in the payload)
cases.expectedControl: transport admission never implies semantic acceptance: closed-shape validation refuses; nothing executes
cases.actualResult: bus receipt stands (transport), proposal refused proposal_malformed (unknown field), no proposal record, no execution

cases.attack: quarantine resurrection (terminal peer retries enrollment/admission)
cases.expectedControl: quarantined is terminal: every transition attempt refuses; state stays quarantined
cases.actualResult: both retries refused; readPeer confirms trustState=quarantined

cases.attack: key substitution (attacker key mounted under A's NodeId tail)
cases.expectedControl: the verifier binds the subject's fingerprint CLAIM to the verifying key: mismatch refuses
cases.actualResult: stage=signature failureCode=signature_stage_refused (fingerprint_claim_mismatch)

cases.attack: lineage tamper (dangling causation id)
cases.expectedControl: well-formedness pins: no self-reference, no dups, no dangling causation
cases.actualResult: failureCode=lineage_malformed; no receipt, no inbox entry

cases.attack: confused deputy (Policy allow for agent X presented with agent Y's assignment)
cases.expectedControl: the fresh-authorization gate binds the Policy decision to the assigned actor
cases.actualResult: REPAIRED IN-GATE: gate refused with failureCode=actor_mismatch after policyActorId binding was added (the 24A in-gate-repair precedent); re-proven by tests

cases.attack: direct tool-runtime reach attempt (proposal/candidate → executeToolRun)
cases.expectedControl: structural isolation: zero execution/network tokens in federation code; the gate accepts no proposal-only input
cases.actualResult: static scan across 6 modules: 0 hits; runtime attempt refused no_local_allocation

cases.attack: old Policy reuse (allow from a previous epoch/window)
cases.expectedControl: fresh-action window: reusing an old Policy decision is forbidden
cases.actualResult: failureCode=stale_local_policy; fresh evaluation required

cases.attack: registry corruption/recovery (terminal peer across restart)
cases.expectedControl: peer facts are durable and terminal: recovery restores quarantined EXACTLY, never resurrects
cases.actualResult: post-restart readPeer=quarantined; post-restart transition refused

cases.attack: restart+replay (the exact admitted envelope replayed after restart, empty key directory)
cases.expectedControl: durable receipt index + durable proposal index refuse across epochs with zero signature evaluation
cases.actualResult: replay_detected (durable receipt guard, no signature evaluation); proposal id still present (durable guard intact)

cases.attack: oversized message (envelope > 8192 canonical bytes)
cases.expectedControl: pinned byte bounds; refusing to widen is the control

cases.attack: evidence tamper (forged receiverDecision in a durable receipt)
cases.expectedControl: append-only kinds reject every rewrite; recovery re-verifies hashes (22E)
cases.actualResult: store.persist refused (append-only)

cases.attack: concurrent peer-state conflict (same transactionId with conflicting reasons; post-conflict flip-back)
cases.expectedControl: no last-writer-wins: duplicate transaction ids resolve as idempotent replay at the ORIGINAL revision; terminal states refuse every flip

cases.actualResult: attack cannot be constructed against any public surface; static scan across 6 modules: 0 merge/union APIs. Recorded UNSUPPORTED — unsupported is NOT PASS

cases.expectedControl: persistence is ONLY the 23B acceptMutation junction; no network or spawn surface exists in any federation module
cases.actualResult: attack cannot be constructed: static scan across 6 modules found 0 direct .persist( calls and 0 network/spawn imports. Recorded UNSUPPORTED — unsupported is NOT PASS
